origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): a client of the SDKs that drop the id of a call writes two calls of the same function in one turn and their answers by name only; each answer is given to the call it answers, first in, first out, and every call has an id of its own. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
